newsitem.title: USA: Coltec to sell unit to Tenneco unit.
newsitem.headline: Coltec to sell unit to Tenneco unit.

text.p: Coltec Industries Inc said on Tuesday it had agreed in principle to sell the assets of its truck muffler and exhaust manufacturing operation to Walker Manufacturing, a unit of Tenneco Inc.
Terms of the transaction, which is expected to close in 1996's fourth quarter, were not disclosed.
Coltec's muffler and exhaust operation is part of the company's Stemco Truck Products Division in Longview, Texas. It had sales of about $20 million in 1995.
John W. Guffey Jr., Coltec's chairman, president and chief executive, said, "This pending transaction continues our policy of exiting businesses in which we do not have a leading market share."
